reserveReview.rationale: BDO Malta directly confirmed EUR 32.448 million across three designated cash reserve accounts at licensed European financial institutions on August 1, 2024. STASIS's latest published daily statement is a December 12, 2025 NexPay euro account statement, which corroborates the continued cash-account model but does not support splitting the complete reserve across current providers.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Latest complete third-party EURS cash-reserve procedures report; current provider allocation undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No material reserve asset class is unclassified; current account-level provider shares are not publicly disclosed by the latest complete report set.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The December 2025 statement identifies NexPay for one EURS reserve account, but it does not establish the complete current provider set or allocation. The three provider categories in the August 2024 BDO report are historical and are not carried forward as current providers. Current segregation across all accounts, statutory bankruptcy remoteness, provider shares, and rehypothecation terms remain unknown.
